单元并排，主瓣垂直于阵列平面。: Elements side by side, with the main lobe perpendicular to the plane of the array.
单元数加倍时理论增益约 +3 dB（需满足间距与同相馈电）。: Doubling the number of elements gives about +3 dB theoretical gain (provided the spacing and in-phase feeding are right).
单元轴向排列，主瓣沿阵列轴线方向。: Elements arranged along the axis, with the main lobe along the array axis.
单元间距通常取 0.5–1 个波长，过近耦合强、过远产生栅瓣。: Element spacing is usually 0.5–1 wavelength: too close gives strong coupling, too far produces grating lobes.
各单元需等幅同相馈电，用功分器或匹配网络保证一致性。: All elements must be fed with equal amplitude and phase, using splitters or matching networks for consistency.
垂直方向串联半波单元，水平全向、垂直压缩。: Half-wave elements stacked vertically: omnidirectional in azimuth with a compressed vertical pattern.
堆叠单元数每加倍，增益约 +3 dB，同时主瓣变窄。: Each doubling of stacked elements gives about +3 dB of gain while the main lobe narrows.
多个八木上下/左右并列，增益提高、波束变窄。: Several Yagis placed one above another or side by side: gain rises and the beam narrows.
多个单元按一定间距与相位排列，合成定向波束。: Several elements arranged with a set spacing and phase, forming a directional beam.
电控相位，波束可快速扫描，无需机械转动。: Electronically controlled phase lets the beam scan rapidly with no mechanical rotation.
相控阵用移相器控制波束，适合 VHF/UHF 及以上频段。: Phased arrays use phase shifters to steer the beam and suit VHF/UHF and above.
通过调整各单元相位，使主瓣指向特定方向。: Adjusting the phase of each element so the main lobe points in a chosen direction.
阵列中各单元信号的矢量叠加，决定波束方向与旁瓣。: The vector sum of the element signals, which sets the beam direction and sidelobes.
